review_count_2021: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2021_reviews FROM reviews
review_count_2022: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2022_reviews FROM reviews
review_ratio: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS ratio FROM reviews
